treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Armenia and the Kingdom of Belgium for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2001, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [AM MLI position] ...on Capital Kingdom of Belgium Original 07-06-2001 23-09-2003 || [BE MLI] Convention entre le Royaume de Belgique et la République d'Arménie ... Arménie Original 07-06-2001 01-10-2004
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the AM-BE Convention (MLI_SynthesisedText_Amenia_Belgium.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the equity capital of the company paying the dividends; [MLI Art. 8(1):] Subparagraph a) of paragraph 2 of Article 10 of the Convention shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source on sale-on-credit of equipment/capital goods between enterprises, on loans (not bearer) granted by a banking enterprise, and paid to the other State/subdivisions/local authorities. 365-day holding period for the 5% dividend tier added by MLI Art. 8(1), effective for WHT from 2024-01-01 (before that no holding period). Art. 29: WHT provisions effective for income credited or payable on or after 1 January of the year following EIF; valid_from 2004-01-01 assumes EIF 2003-09-23 (Armenia) - Belgium's MLI position gives EIF 2004-10-01, which would give 2005-01-01. MLI WHT effect 2024-01-01 from treaty map.
unverified: entry_into_force (conflict 2003-09-23 vs 2004-10-01) and hence valid_from of the treaty rates
